Its gold ornamentations leave an impression, but its true value lies in its solid craftsmanship.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== The Royal Bridle is a [[Bridle]] that can be obtained from [[Toffa]] by completing "[[The Royal White Stallion]]" [[Side Quest]]. Prior to the second [[Great Calamity]], [[Princess Zelda|Zelda]] equipped her [[White Horse]] with the custom-made Royal Bridle and its counterpart, the [[Royal Saddle]], as part of an attempt to bond with her [[Horse]].{{Cite|At first, I wasn't sure if I should outfit him with all of the royal gear. I thought maybe he should have to earn it first. But it works! He wears it like a true natural.|Zelda|BotW}}{{Cite|I'm trying to be a bit more empathetic. Benefit of the doubt, you know?|Zelda|BotW}} Following the Great Calamity, Toffa's grandfather inherited the Royal Bridle and passed it down to Toffa.{{Cite|What? You brought the royal family's {{Color BotW|Red|white horse}}? Well I'll be... Grandpa wasn't lying! Son, you just made my life. Staying alive in this godforsaken land may just have been worth it after all.|Toffa|BotW}} By registering the White Horse at a [[Stable]] and showing it to Toffa, the elderly man will gift [[Link]] the Royal Bridle and Royal Saddle and equip them onto the Horse.{{Cite|I've got a surprise for you. My grandpa handed this down to me, and now I'm handing it down to you. I present to you...the royal family's saddle and bridle! Custom fitted for the white royal horse!|Toffa|BotW}} The Royal Bridle is a piece of [[Royal Horse Gear]], which is a set of [[Horse Gear]].{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 161}} It can be equipped to any Horse by speaking to specific workers at [[Highland Stable]], Outskirt Stable, [[South Akkala Stable]], or [[Woodland Stable]].{{Cite|Change to {{Color BotW|Red|Royal Bridle}}?|Canni|BotW}} However, it is unable to be worn by [[Epona]] or the [[Giant Horse]].{{Cite|Hello there! That's a mighty find horse you have. If you like, I can change out her {{Color BotW|Blue|gear}} or maybe... Oh? Actually, this horse is different from any I've ever seen before. My, she's so lovely and graceful... I'm sorry, but I'm pretty sure this little lady would absolutely hate it if you changed her mane or gear. I'm so sorry about that.|Canni|BotW}}{{Cite|Hello there! That's a mighty find horse you have. If you like, I can change out its {{Color BotW|Blue|gear}} or maybe... Oh? My goodness, that's no pony, is it? It's so big! I'm sorry, but I don't think I have any {{Color BotW|Blue|gear}} that'd fit such a large horse, and I bet it wouldn't like its {{Color BotW|Blue|mane}} handled... I'm so sorry about that.|Canni|BotW}} The Royal Bridle is well-known for its craftsmanship and how much the [[Royal Family of Hyrule]] favored it. The Royal Bridle can be seen equipped to Zelda's White Horse during the special cutscene that plays after the credits for {{BotW}}, but only if the "[[Captured Memories]]" [[Main Quest]] has been completed. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Bridle * Horse Gear * Royal Horse Gear * Royal Saddle }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Bridles, Horse Gear |items= BotW, TotK |key-items= BotW, TotK }}
